installConfigs.instructions: Official remote Trello MCP server. No API key is required: on first connection Theia opens a browser to authorize access to your Trello account via OAuth, then stores the resulting token automatically. Provides tools to manage Trello boards, lists, cards, checklists, search, and Planner focus-time events.
